text: Diagnostic tooling must avoid acquiring exclusive database locks or triggering unindexed catalogue lookups during production incidents.
Streaming BSON parsers must enforce strict chunk buffer caps to prevent diagnostic tools from inducing OOM kills on memory-constrained replica nodes.
Capturing full query documents without regex-based PII redaction creates severe data governance and compliance violations in diagnostic bundles.
Use query-shape normalization (stripping constants while retaining predicates) to allow deterministic error grouping without leaking sensitive field values.
Symptom: Diagnostic scraper causes replica set election. Cause: Scraper command timeout holding db lock. Fix: Use non-blocking serverStatus with small timeout.
